written_before: running scripts/x1_ridge_canary.py and scripts/x2_ridge_holdout.py in this session
lane: H2 label-free magnetic lineament candidate (docs/research/hypotheses.md, H2)
hypothesis: A Hessian ridge/valley centreline score on the reduced-to-pole field (band 2), packed at >= 2.8 px spacing into binary dots, recovers held-out catalogue fault segments better than the frozen 19-band HGB top-N emission at the same dot budget.
mechanism: Linear magnetic discontinuities (bright ridges: dykes, magnetite-rich contacts; dark valleys: hydrothermally demagnetised fault zones) mark structural lineaments. Band 2 is label-free, so the score cannot leak labels.
non_fault_confounders: Lithologic contacts and intrusive dykes produce linear magnetic anomalies without displacement.
Survey flight-line and tie-line levelling artefacts produce straight, orientation-locked linear features.
Topographic/terrain magnetic effects along valleys and ridges.
dot_budget_rationale: 44,090 is the dot count of the team's d2.8 Poisson family (the 0.26-0.28 cluster on the team's own public-board receipts). It is fixed before the holdout is run; it is NOT chosen from holdout results.

arms.hgb_bands: frozen baseline: HistGradientBoostingClassifier on the 19 label-free bands, top-N probability emission (scripts/exp2_holdout_arms.py, bands arm, same RNG seed 53)
arms.ridge_pack: candidate: ridge centrelines + Poisson-disk packing at 2.8 px, binary dots
arms.ridge_topn: ablation: ridge centrelines, top-N by L with NO spacing rule (isolates the packing effect)

design.visible_mask: known faults outside the fold, masked pixel-exactly from every emission
design.scorer: shared template src/metrics.py GtContext (pooled TP_w, FP_w, FN_w summed over folds, then one DTI)
design.label_type: HOLDOUT-DTI (proxy: withheld catalogue segments; NOT the competition's new-fault truth)

gates.G1_holdout_best: pooled HOLDOUT-DTI of ridge_pack at N=44090 must exceed 0.035233
gates.G2_equal_budget: paired per-fold difference ridge_pack - hgb_bands at N=44090 must have a 95% t-interval (df 4) with lower bound > 0
gates.G3_leakage_canary: every ridge-derived feature, tested alone on the holdout, must have separability <= 0.90
gates.G4_format: shared template validator passes: float32, single band, EPSG:32611, 100 m, template transform/shape, NaN exactly outside the sample footprint, finite values in [0,1] inside it
gates.G5_uniqueness: against every public GEMS registry raster: Spearman <= 0.90 and <= 70% of our dots within 3 px of that raster's dots, checked on the surface before placement AND on the final dots

promotion_rule: Label 'Validated / OK to submit' only if G1-G5 all pass. Otherwise label 'Research-only / DO NOT SUBMIT' and name the failing gate(s). No weekly slot is chosen in this session.
budget: 3 experiments (X1 canary, X2 holdout, X3 build+checks) and 2 hours, per the parallel-run protocol
